meta.name: Sniper Reloaded
meta.description: Marine Sgt. Brandon Beckett, son of the U.S. Marine Corps' deadliest sniper, Thomas Beckett, must turn to his father's former protégé (Billy Zane) to track down and kill a mysterious sniper before he kills his next target.
meta.slogan: Deep in the Congo, Marine... Peace Keeper... Killer.
